sentences.text: Elizabeth Anne `` Lizzy '' Caplan -LRB- born June 30 , 1982 -RRB- is an American actress .

After starting her career in the critically acclaimed television series Freaks and Geeks in 1999 , Caplan started to get wider attention for her roles in films Mean Girls -LRB- 2004 -RRB- and Cloverfield -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , the latter earned her a nomination for the Saturn Award for Best Supporting Actress .
